notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1936 date and the L-4 design appear on two pages (firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com); the sources do not show whether these are independent, so treat them as one report until checked. The staff list (1934 to 1950) is 'known' personnel, not a full roster. The 1934 Howard Green item is cited on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page to a Bonners Ferry Herald item that was not read. No source describes the site today, and none gives an access statement; the only access note is the 'Hike-In' tag. The FFLA list gives the same point as the record (48.99719, -116.64592). The record has no events; 1936 is added as built, which the editor may want to check. Verification pass: the 1936 entry, the Howard Green item (dated 06/07/1934 on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page) and the 'Removed' status on the Forest Lookouts page were confirmed in context. A footnote was added to the first sentence. No facts changed.
